_instructions: Copy this to BINDING.json and fill in every path. bind_assets.py then fills the hashes.
Every input is a plain TSV except the genotype triple, so nothing here needs a compiled reader.
Leave burden_path null to run the detectability gate only; the bar needs it.
_samples_schema: TSV: sample_id [group] [split]. group = kinship/family component, one row per analysed individual. split is optional; if absent it is derived deterministically from the seed and the group column.
_covariates_schema: TSV: sample_id then numeric columns (age, sex, genotype PCs, assessment centre dummies, batch dummies). No missing values.
_phenotypes_schema: TSV: sample_id then one column per trait, already inverse-normalised or otherwise pre-adjusted as your analysis plan states.
_genes_schema: TSV: gene_id, chrom, tss (1-based). chrom must match the .bim naming exactly.
_burden_schema: TSV: gene_id, trait, beta, se. One row per gene x trait. Must come from an independent WES analysis, never from the array data used here.
_traits_note: Column names in phenotypes_path to analyse, e.g. ["RBC", "HGB", "MCV"].
_chromosomes_note: Restrict the run, e.g. ["1","2"]. Empty means every chromosome present in genes_path.
